title: Agentic tool-call rulebook (v1) — role + Bayesian-gated preconditions
description: Minimal typed ontology for a coding/agentic session: an Actor operating under a Role proposes Actions against Tools and Resources; Actions are admissible iff type-legal (thread-1 guarantee), role-legal, and gated on Claims currently satisfying the action's RiskTier via the live Bayesian posterior (bayesian_gate.py). Quantity/Time appear as max_per_window/window_seconds rate limits. This is the smoke-tier fixture for agentic_ontology.py + the Modal harness's first Gemma run.
notes: risk_tier values map to bayesian_gate.RiskTier: low/medium/high/critical.
preconditions are claim ids; the enforcer queries a live ClaimStore, not a static table — see agentic_ontology.AgenticTLTS.admissible_for.
This is a hand-built v1 fixture, not derived from a real tool schema yet. Next step is generating this from an actual Hetzner agentic model's tool manifest (see plan).
